column1: # Table of adopted parameters for spiral arms in PHANGS environmental masks v5
# This table lists only galaxies where at least one spiral arm segment was retained after Quality Assurance (see README)
# Col.2: Number of spiral arm segment (same label as in the mask FITS file)
# Col.3: Width of the segment in pc (negative values = width set to average arm width for that galaxy if low CO coverage
# Col.4: Minimum radius (px) of the fitted segment on the deprojected Spitzer/IRAC 3.6um map
# Col.5: Maximum radius (px) of the fitted segment on the deprojected Spitzer/IRAC 3.6um map
# Col.6: Intercept of ln(R) vs theta linear fit in polar coordinates (R=px in the deprojected image)
# Col.7: Slope of ln(R) vs theta linear fit in polar coordinates (R=px in the deprojected image)
# Col.10: Adopted disc position angle for deprojection (deg)
# Col.11: Adopted disc inclination for deprojection (deg)
# Col.12: Adopted distance (Mpc); it only affects the effective width of segments (transformation from pc to arcsec)
# Col.13: Indicator of whether galaxy is in S4G survey or not ("S4G" or "non-S4G")
# Col.14: Azimuthal extension of the segment along the arm inwards from the minimum radius of the fitted segment (deg)
# Col.15: Azimuthal extension of the segment along the arm outwards from the maximum radius of the fitted segment (deg)
